These three permissions are what make the app work. Each one opens the official Android flow — nothing is granted behind your back.
%s could not be stopped: the system restarts it automatically. Blocking it applies a deeper background restriction.
Fecha Tudo Plus helps you control which apps run in the background. You can stop, restrict, block, freeze, or schedule cleanups — all without root, using Shizuku.

Android does not let an ordinary app read other apps\' processes or really stop them. Shizuku is a separate app that grants that access using debug shell permissions, without root. With it authorized, Fecha Tudo Plus reads the real memory of each process and stops apps for good. Without it the app still works, but only lists recently used apps and stopping stays limited by Android. Shizuku is not made by us and needs to be started again after each restart of the device.

The app is provided as is, with no warranty. Stopping apps can lose unsaved data and interrupt downloads, alarms, messages and notifications. Essential system apps are protected automatically, but the final choice of what to stop or block is yours, and so is the responsibility for the outcome. Nothing here requires root, nothing is changed permanently in the system, and every restriction applied is undone when you unblock the app. Scheduled groups act on their own at the time you set: check what you put in them, because a group in Force stop mode will close those apps without asking.

No data leaves your device. The app has no account, no login and no server. It collects no usage statistics, shows no ads and shares nothing with third parties. It does not even declare the internet permission, so it has no way to send anything anywhere. The list of installed apps and the memory readings are used only to draw the screens and are never stored outside your device.

Your lists live in a local SQLite database and the settings in DataStore, both inside the app\'s private area, which other apps cannot read. Cloud backup is turned off on purpose: uninstalling erases everything, and a reinstall starts from scratch, with nothing restored behind your back. Special permissions are granted by you on the official Android screens and can be revoked there at any time. Schedules live in the same local database and are re-registered with the system alarm after each reboot.

System apps sustain functions of the device: telephony, notifications, connectivity, interface. Stopping one can freeze the phone, drop calls or silence alarms until you restart it. Several are restarted by Android right away. Only go ahead if you know what each package does — the responsibility for the outcome is yours.
Intervals under 15 seconds are raised to 15: below that Android starts delaying the alarms on its own and the battery cost stops paying off.

Shows apps running in the foreground or recently used. Tap an app to force-stop it: it is immediately terminated and removed from recents. With the system-apps toggle you see everything, including core services — handle with care.

Apps on this list are never stopped by the magic button or batch actions. Use it to protect your launcher, keyboard, wallet, and essential services. Defaults are detected automatically from your device.

Blocked apps are suspended, have their background permissions cut, and are placed in the restricted standby bucket. The watcher service keeps reapplying the block every minute so they cannot come back on their own — even Play Services.
Freezing fully disables the app (pm disable-user). It disappears from the drawer, cannot start at all, and uses no memory. The strongest option. Requires Shizuku. Unfreeze at any time to restore it.
Create groups with a name, a set of apps, and a time. Choose the mode: force-stop, block, restrict, or freeze. Runs once or on repeat by weekday or interval. The alarm fires even with the screen off.

A floating button that stays on top of every app. Tap it once to stop all non-protected apps. Hold it for 2 seconds to jump straight to bubble settings. Drag to position it anywhere on screen — position is remembered.
Requires Shizuku to freeze or unfreeze apps.
Tap Add below to choose apps to freeze.
